name: an-assent-to-build-builds
turns: I'm investigating stage-specific expression in Plasmodium falciparum.
Yes, rerun the differential expression and then create the strategy step from the genes that pass.
rationale: Assent to the assistant's own offer is a request to build. The cataloged run classified two such imperatives as questions, hid the building tools and answered that the controls were unavailable, so two turns produced nothing. This is the counterpart of question-turns-do-not-build: a turn that accepts an offer and names a step must persist a strategy AST.

provenance.curatorNote: The second turn is the measured phrasing, unchanged.
